plan_metadata.title: Behaviour-First Ten-Case Correction and Proof Plan

supersedes.scope: The policy-correction sequence and its case acceptance criteria.

objective.primary: Define, approve, implement, and prove an evidence-grounded behavioural contract for every supplied case before undertaking broader platform hardening.
objective.release_blocker: CB-2025-0004 must complete end to end while treating its persuasive internal fraud report as relevant merchant-authored evidence that satisfies zero Mastercard 4837 qualifying routes.
required_distinctions: Qualifying evidence that satisfies a scheme requirement.
Relevant evidence that does not satisfy a scheme requirement.
Evidence that may exist but was not found.
Evidence that cannot establish the claimed fact.
Qualifying evidence buried inside a long document.
objective.recommendation_rule: Suggested analyst action is separate from RecommendationResult. REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE must never replace the recommendation derived from the currently admitted record.

non_negotiable_invariants: Preserve every take-home-v3 policy file, hash, persisted selection, run, result, review package, and analyst decision unchanged.
Introduce corrected behaviour only under a new additive take-home-v4 rulebook.
Do not change the default rulebook from v3 until the complete v4 acceptance suite is approved.
Model output may propose facts; deterministic validation alone admits them.
Document relevance, persuasive wording, model confidence, and merchant confidence have zero direct influence on deterministic policy evaluation.
NOT_FOUND never proves the opposite value.
AMBIGUOUS and CONFLICTING remain visible and cannot be silently collapsed into FOUND or NOT_FOUND.
Invalid extraction remains fail-closed and produces no partial FactResolutionResult, evaluation, recommendation, or review package.
Corrections to extraction values occur at the exact schema, typing, normalisation, or provenance boundary that rejected them.
No fuzzy citation matching, unstructured fallback, silent output repair, provider substitution, or model substitution.
Every rerun creates a new immutable attempt and lineage.
A cached result reopens from persistence without a provider call.

approval_gates.name: Ten-case behavioural matrix approval
approval_gates.required_before: Changing policies, extraction contracts, predicates, recommendation mappings, or fixtures.
approval_gates.rule: No expected outcome may be copied from an existing persisted recommendation without independent support from cases.json, supplied evidence, and the source rulebook.

approval_gates.name: Source semantics approval
focus: Visa 13.3 alternative comparison and return-route semantics

approval_gates.name: Single-case live validation
approval_gates.required_before: Running all ten cases live under v4.

approval_gates.name: Default-version promotion
approval_gates.required_before: Changing the application default from take-home-v3 to take-home-v4.

phase_sequence.name: Protect and verify the historical checkpoint
writes_allowed: New audit reports and checksum manifests only.
tasks: Record branch, commit, worktree status, Python version, dependency lock state, and database paths.
Run the complete ordinary test suite with python -m pytest -q.
Verify the committed data/demo-validation.db checksum.
Generate and verify a SHA-256 manifest for every take-home-v3 rulebook file.
Open historical databases read-only and record integrity_check, foreign_key_check, schema hashes, and table counts.
Do not migrate, vacuum, checkpoint, reconfigure, or rewrite historical databases.
phase_sequence.stop_condition: Stop if baseline tests fail or a historical checksum differs; report the discrepancy before continuing.
definition_of_done: The existing v3 pipeline remains available.

phase_sequence.name: Produce the ten-case behavioural acceptance matrix
phase_sequence.implementation_rule: This is a read-only evidence and policy audit. No production behaviour changes in this phase.
audit_method: Load scheme, reason code, case metadata, and declared filenames from the immutable case records.
Verify evidence hashes and file formats without modifying files.
Inspect every page of every PDF and every supplied image.
Record exact document page counts; do not rely on existing summaries.
Map source rulebook language to explicit qualifying routes, alternatives, examples, defaults, and non-qualifying evidence.
Classify every proposed fact as qualifying, relevant-but-insufficient, absent, ambiguous, conflicting, or unable to establish the claimed conclusion.
Derive expected requirement grades using three-valued logic.
Derive the recommendation from the approved requirement aggregation and recommendation mapping.
Derive suggested analyst action separately from the recommendation.
Mark any result that cannot be established from the source as unresolved rather than inventing an expected outcome.

case_inventory.acceptance_focus: Determine whether the supplied delivery and tracking records satisfy each applicable Visa 13.1 route; do not equate a tracking identifier with completed delivery.
Distinguish order placement and tracking activity from qualifying proof of delivery.
Evaluate each recognised Mastercard 4837 route independently and apply only the source-approved aggregation.

fixed_behaviour.avs_cvv_route: NOT_SATISFIED because recorded AVS and CVV values are N.
fixed_behaviour.prior_transactions_route: NOT_SATISFIED because the account and transaction were new/first.
fixed_behaviour.signed_delivery_route: NOT_ESTABLISHED because signed delivery to the billing address is not supplied.
fixed_behaviour.required_explanation: The merchant report and confidence score are relevant assertions but do not satisfy a recognised Mastercard 4837 evidence route.

case_inventory.acceptance_focus: Establish duplicate-processing semantics from transaction-specific invoice evidence without assuming two documents necessarily prove an invalid duplicate.
Limit visual evidence to visible attributes and preserve alternative product-comparison and return-route semantics.
forbidden_inferences: All product characteristics match the listing.
The customer used or completed a return route.
NOT_FOUND visible damage means no damage exists.

case_inventory.acceptance_focus: Find transaction txn_7745MN on page 8 of the 10-page manifest and compare collection/delivery postcode LS9 8AA with frozen shipping postcode LS9 8AA.
case_inventory.forbidden_behaviour: Do not substitute billing postcode LS1 4DT for the shipping postcode.

case_inventory.acceptance_focus: Distinguish general subscription policy from customer-specific proof of notice, opt-in, non-cancellation, and policy execution.
Recognise NO-SHOW without changing its meaning and calculate late cancellation deterministically from timestamps and the policy deadline.
Apply the policy-defined default accept-liability/do-not-represent disposition when no qualifying exception route is established.

definition_of_done: Every case has a populated matrix row.
Every expected outcome cites case data, evidence, and rulebook source.
Gate G1 approval is obtained before implementation.

phase_sequence.name: Diagnose and correct the CB-2025-0004 extraction boundary
tasks: Reproduce the current EvidenceCandidateValueError in a new isolated validation database with explicit debug diagnostics.
Identify the exact candidate path, requested fact, catalogue type, returned runtime type, provenance, and rejected value.
Classify the failure as provider schema, controlled vocabulary, value typing, cardinality, citation, or provenance incompatibility.
Add a narrow failing regression test before changing code.
Correct only the responsible provider schema, extraction prompt, controlled normalisation, or adapter boundary.
Retain strict local admission and reject the entire response if any candidate remains invalid.
Extract and cite factual report assertions without admitting the report's legitimacy conclusion or confidence score as a qualifying policy fact.
required_fact_behaviour: AVS result N remains an observed recorded value.
CVV result N remains an observed recorded value.
3DS not attempted remains an observed recorded status.
New account/first transaction remains a merchant-record assertion.
No signed-delivery fact is admitted unless supplied evidence establishes it.
Merchant confidence or legitimacy conclusion is retained only as a source-qualified non-qualifying assertion if displayed.
policy_behaviour: Evaluate all recognised Mastercard 4837 routes independently.
Zero routes may be marked satisfied.
Apply the source-approved aggregation and default disposition.
List the exact qualifying evidence that could change each route.
Do not turn a suggested REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE action into the recommendation.
tests: The same invalid untrusted value still fails closed in a contract test.
Merchant confidence values cannot appear in any qualifying predicate binding.
Changing the report's confidence score does not change grades or recommendation.
No partial resolution or recommendation is created from invalid provider output.
All citations resolve to the correct fraud-report page.
definition_of_done: A fixture-backed immutable attempt completes with zero satisfied Mastercard 4837 routes.
The persisted package clearly separates report assertions from qualifying evidence.
The result reopens without provider execution.

phase_sequence.name: Implement the approved additive take-home-v4 semantics
rulebook_rules: Provision all eight policy keys, even where four remain semantically equivalent to approved v3 behaviour.
Give every v4 policy a new policy ID, snapshot hash, exact citations, and registered facts.
Never update a v3 policy row or selection snapshot.
Validate all policies and facts in a fresh database before use.

case_corrections.change: Encode each Mastercard 4837 qualifying route as an independently traceable requirement or predicate branch and preserve the source-approved aggregation/default.

Represent photos, specifications, and serial matching as source-approved alternatives rather than universal cumulative facts; model return/non-use and post-complaint-use/retention as alternative routes.
case_corrections.guardrail: Visual non-observation of damage is never evidence that no damage exists.

case_corrections.change: Compare the transaction-scoped delivery address/postcode with frozen shipping details; billing details may not replace shipping details.
case_corrections.predicate: Use an approved deterministic address comparison with UNKNOWN for missing comparison inputs.

case_corrections.change: Separate GENERAL_POLICY assertions from CASE_SPECIFIC_EXECUTION assertions.
case_corrections.guardrail: General terms cannot satisfy customer-specific notice, consent, cancellation, or execution requirements.

case_corrections.change: Use controlled NFKC/trim/casefold comparison for the exact NO-SHOW vocabulary and a deterministic timezone-aware deadline predicate.
Use a versioned policy-specific recommendation mapping that returns do-not-represent when the qualifying exception is not established.
case_corrections.guardrail: The evaluator keeps UNKNOWN semantics; the policy-defined default is applied by deterministic recommendation mapping.

new_or_extended_contracts.change: Add or enforce assertion_scope with GENERAL_POLICY, CASE_SPECIFIC_RECORD, VISUAL_OBSERVATION, and CASE_METADATA where needed.
new_or_extended_contracts.reason: Prevents general policy language from satisfying a case-specific requirement.

new_or_extended_contracts.change: Add only source-required generic operators such as fact-to-fact comparison and timezone-aware deadline comparison.
new_or_extended_contracts.rule: Operators must be scheme-agnostic and tested independently of case IDs.

new_or_extended_contracts.change: Support exact policy/version-specific default dispositions followed by validated global fallbacks.
new_or_extended_contracts.rule: Reject zero matches, overlapping matches, lineage mismatch, and hash mismatch.

definition_of_done: All v4 policies and citations validate.
All ten case keys have exact v4 coverage.
Every requested fact has one controlled definition.
No comparison, recommendation, or policy conclusion is delegated to the model.
v3 hashes and historical results remain unchanged.

phase_sequence.name: Guarantee complete document search and source-scoped evidence handling
tasks: Verify PDF conversion processes every page in original order.
Verify CB-2025-0007 produces exactly 10 EvidencePage records.
Ensure the extraction request includes all converted pages within provider limits using deterministic page batching if necessary.
If batching is required, preserve document ID, page number, source hash, batch identity, and deterministic merge order.
Require transaction-specific facts to bind to the matching transaction identifier when a long document contains multiple records.
Require supporting_text to match canonical page text using only the shared tested Unicode/whitespace normalisation.
Never treat failure to find page-8 evidence as proof that delivery did not occur.
Mark incomplete conversion, omitted pages, or provider truncation as a typed failure or explicit NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN according to the approved contract.
cb_2025_0007_acceptance: Transaction txn_7745MN is located on page 8.
The admitted delivery/collection postcode is LS9 8AA.
The comparison uses frozen shipping postcode LS9 8AA.
A regression test fails if billing postcode LS1 4DT is substituted.
Represent is recommended only if every applicable approved requirement is satisfied.
cb_2025_0008_acceptance: Subscription terms are admitted as general policy assertions.
They do not establish customer notice, opt-in, non-cancellation, or case-specific execution.
Each missing customer-specific proof appears as an evidence gap.
tests: PDF conversion preserves all pages and page numbers.
Batching neither drops nor duplicates pages.
Transaction-scoped extraction rejects facts from a different record.
General-policy assertions cannot bind to case-specific predicates.

phase_sequence.name: Separate recommendation from suggested analyst action

new_contract.name: SuggestedAnalystAction
fields: requested_items: ordered tuple of specific evidence descriptions
causal_requirement_ids: ordered tuple of requirement IDs

assembly_rules: RecommendationResult is assembled and frozen first.
SuggestedAnalystAction is deterministically derived from unresolved requirement bindings and approved policy evidence-route descriptions.
Suggested action cannot alter recommendation, grades, or workflow lineage.
REQUEST_SPECIFIC_EVIDENCE must name evidence capable of changing an unresolved route.
Do not request evidence for a route already deterministically disproven unless the approved policy allows rebuttal evidence.
The analyst review package displays recommendation and suggested action in separate sections.

possible_requested_items: Evidence of successful 3D Secure authentication, if it exists.
Evidence of two prior undisputed transactions, if it exists.
Signed delivery evidence tied to the billing address, if operationally obtainable.
cb_2025_0004_example.rule: The final requested list must come from the approved Mastercard 4837 matrix, not this illustrative plan text.

tests: Changing suggested action does not change recommendation hash.
A do-not-represent recommendation may coexist with request-more-evidence.
Requested evidence maps to unresolved qualifying routes.
Cached package reopening does not regenerate or call a model.

phase_sequence.name: Persist, display, and reopen corrected packages
persistence_rules: Use a new v4 validation database.
Persist each new run, selection, conversion, resolution, evaluation, recommendation, suggested action, and review package as an immutable record.
Link every aggregate through IDs and content hashes.
Reject duplicate selection, resolution, evaluation, recommendation, or package creation for the same immutable lineage.
Record failed attempts separately without partial downstream aggregates.
Never overwrite v3 rows or reuse a v3 policy snapshot for a v4 run.
review_package_display: Current advisory recommendation and business-equivalent disposition.
Ordered requirement grades and deterministic basis.
Facts that were deliberately not inferred.
Rulebook, policy, model, prompt, schema, and aggregate lineage.
ui_rules: Selecting a corrected completed case loads its persisted package without model execution.
Selecting a failed or unprocessed case clears the previous case's recommendation, facts, evidence, citations, gaps, and action.
tests: A persisted v4 package equals its reconstructed aggregate.
Restarting the application and reopening a package creates zero provider calls.
Cross-case switching never displays stale evidence or recommendation.
A failed attempt has no downstream aggregate IDs.

phase_sequence.name: Execute the complete proof sequence

execution_order.name: Contract tests
execution_order.scope: Catalogue, assertion scope, normalisation, predicate logic, recommendation defaults, suggested action, and lineage.

execution_order.name: Fixture-backed all-case suite
execution_order.scope: All ten cases, each compared against the approved behavioural matrix.

execution_order.name: Full regression suite
execution_order.rule: Ordinary tests make zero live-provider calls.

execution_order.name: Single live v4 case
execution_order.rule: Use a new validation database and configured provider; preserve all failures honestly.

execution_order.name: All-case live validation
execution_order.approval: Separate approval after the single live case.
execution_order.rule: One case failure does not terminate later cases; every status or safe error is persisted.

required_regressions: 0004: confident merchant language satisfies zero Mastercard 4837 routes.
0004: confidence-score changes do not affect recommendation.
0007: page-8 evidence is found and cited.
0007: shipping postcode is used instead of billing.
0006: visible facts are admitted but hidden condition is not inferred.
0008: general terms are not customer-specific proof.
0010: the policy-specific default outcome is do-not-represent.
Missing evidence never becomes proof of the opposite.
Invalid provider output creates no partial downstream result.
Corrected packages persist and reopen without provider execution.
Cases 0001, 0002, 0003, and 0005 remain consistent with their approved matrix rows.

phase_sequence.name: Resume deferred hardening only after behavioural acceptance
phase_sequence.prerequisite: Phases 0 through 7 pass and the behavioural report is approved.
deferred_work: Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON and busy_timeout on every mutable repository connection through a shared connection factory.
Add controlled backup, verification, WAL, and migration handling for mutable databases.
Show separate machine and analyst workflow state, trusted analyst identity, evidence auto-selection, and attempt history.
Persist provider latency, token usage, model identity, and optional versioned cost calculations.
phase_sequence.rule: These improvements may not be used to postpone or mask a behavioural mismatch.

prohibited_model_tasks: Decide whether a requirement is satisfied.
Decide whether a general policy was followed for this customer.
Decide whether visible appearance proves hidden condition.

failure_behaviour.invalid_extraction: Fail the attempt; persist no partial fact resolution or downstream result.
failure_behaviour.missing_page_or_truncation: Return a typed conversion/extraction failure or approved NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN state; never infer the negative event.
failure_behaviour.citation_mismatch: Reject the candidate with precise safe diagnostics; do not fuzzy match.
failure_behaviour.ambiguous_or_conflicting_fact: Preserve the status and candidates with provenance; deterministic evaluation returns UNKNOWN unless an approved operator explicitly resolves it.
failure_behaviour.missing_policy_or_mapping: Fail closed before evaluation or recommendation.
failure_behaviour.lineage_or_hash_mismatch: Reject reconstruction and surface an integrity failure.
failure_behaviour.single_case_batch_failure: Persist FAILED for that attempt and continue with remaining cases.

required_sections: Exact code, schema, fact-catalogue, policy, predicate, and mapping changes.
New rulebook version and integrity hashes.
Recommendation and suggested action for every case.
Every implemented result that differs from its approved behavioural contract.
Proof that historical v3 hashes and results remain unchanged.
Proof that completed packages reopen without provider execution.
completion_report.completion_rule: Do not declare completion merely because code executes. Completion requires demonstrated agreement with the approved ten-case behavioural contract.

final_definition_of_done: Every supplied case has an approved evidence-grounded behavioural contract.
CB-2025-0004 completes with zero qualifying Mastercard 4837 routes and RECOMMEND_DO_NOT_REPRESENT.
CB-2025-0007 finds and cites transaction txn_7745MN on page 8 and compares LS9 8AA with shipping LS9 8AA.
CB-2025-0006 makes no hidden-condition or defect-free inference from visible appearance.
CB-2025-0008 distinguishes general policy from case-specific execution proof.
CB-2025-0009 uses deterministic NO-SHOW and deadline semantics.
CB-2025-0010 applies its policy-defined default disposition.
Recommendation and suggested analyst action remain separate.
Missing, ambiguous, conflicting, unsupported, and relevant-but-insufficient evidence remain visible.
Successful corrected results persist and reopen without a provider call.
Historical v3 policies and results remain reproducible.
The complete automated test suite passes.
